reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing media utility plugin for DSH that enables local browser-based video/audio-adjacent operations: inspecting video properties, extracting frames, compressing images, and creating GIFs via FFmpeg.wasm. The evidence from README and package metadata consistently describes it as a local, WASM-powered DSH extension with no declared server-side processing.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 的浏览器端媒体工具插件，用于本地处理视频与图像，可进行视频信息查询、抽帧、图片压缩与 GIF 转换。
summaries.en: This is a browser-based DSH media plugin for local processing of video and images, including video metadata inspection, frame extraction, image compression, and GIF conversion.

capabilities: Extract single or evenly-spaced JPEG frames from local video
Compress images to JPEG at a target width
Convert video clips to animated GIF
Run processing through FFmpeg.wasm in browser context
Validate tool inputs via DSH schema definitions

reasons.code: README presents the plugin as browser-local, stating operations run in-browser via WebAssembly and no server uploads.
README lists tools video_info, video_frames, image_compress, and video_to_gif, directly defining the plugin's primary media-processing functions.
Package metadata identifies the package as a DSH media toolset and depends on @ffmpeg/ffmpeg/@ffmpeg/util for processing behavior.
